checks.label: CIS 1.3 - Pattern Visibility Disabled
checks.description: CIS 1.3: Ensure 'Make pattern visible' is set to 'Disabled' to prevent shoulder surfing attacks
checks.remediation: Go to Settings > Security > Screen lock and disable 'Make pattern visible', or run: settings put secure lock_pattern_visible 0

checks.label: CIS 1.5 - Power Button Instantly Locks
checks.description: CIS 1.5: Ensure 'Power button instantly locks' is set to 'Enabled' for immediate device locking
checks.remediation: Go to Settings > Security > Screen lock > Power button instantly locks and enable it, or run: settings put secure lock_screen_lock_after_timeout 0

checks.label: CIS 1.6 - Lock Screen Owner Info Set
checks.description: CIS 1.6: Ensure 'Lock Screen Message' is configured for device identification and emergency contact
checks.remediation: Go to Settings > Security > Lock screen message and enable it, or run: settings put secure lock_screen_owner_info_enabled 1

checks.label: CIS 1.6 - Lock Screen Message Content
checks.description: CIS 1.6: Lock screen message should contain emergency contact or corporate info
checks.remediation: Set a lock screen message with contact info via Settings > Security > Lock screen message, or run: settings put secure lock_screen_owner_info 'Contact info here'

checks.label: CIS 1.13 - Find My Device Enabled
checks.description: CIS 1.13: Ensure 'Find My Device' is set to 'Enabled' for remote locate, lock, and erase capabilities
checks.remediation: Go to Settings > Security > Find My Device and enable it, or run: settings put secure find_my_device 1

checks.label: CIS 1.16 - Device Admin Apps (Remote Wipe)
checks.description: CIS 1.16: Ensure 'Allow remote lock and erase' is enabled via device admin apps
checks.remediation: Go to Settings > Security > Device admin apps and ensure at least one admin app (e.g., Find My Device) is activated.

checks.label: CIS 1.18 - Package Verifier Enabled
checks.description: CIS 1.18: Ensure 'Improve harmful app detection' is enabled for enhanced malware scanning
checks.remediation: Go to Settings > Security > Google Play Protect and enable 'Improve harmful app detection', or run: settings put global package_verifier_enable 1

checks.label: CIS 1.18 - APK Upload for Scanning
checks.description: CIS 1.18: Unknown APKs sent to Google for analysis to improve harmful app detection
checks.remediation: Enable sending unknown apps for scanning via Play Protect settings, or run: settings put global upload_apk_enable 1

checks.label: CIS 1.19 - Screen Pinning Requires Auth
checks.description: CIS 1.19: Ensure 'Ask for PIN/password before unpinning' is enabled when using screen pinning
checks.remediation: Go to Settings > Security > Screen pinning and enable 'Ask for PIN before unpinning', or run: settings put secure lock_to_app_exit_locked 1

checks.label: CIS 1.21 - Wi-Fi Wakeup Disabled
checks.description: CIS 1.21: Ensure 'Wi-Fi assistant/wakeup' is disabled to prevent auto-connecting to untrusted networks
checks.remediation: Go to Settings > Network > Wi-Fi > Wi-Fi preferences and disable 'Turn on Wi-Fi automatically', or run: settings put global wifi_wakeup_enabled 0

checks.label: CIS 1.21 - Network Scoring Disabled
checks.description: CIS 1.21: Network scoring for Wi-Fi assistant should be disabled
checks.remediation: Disable network scoring by running: settings put global network_scoring_provisioned 0

checks.label: CIS 1.22 - App Auto Update Policy
checks.description: CIS 1.22: App auto-update policy (1=WiFi only, 2=always) should be enabled to keep apps updated
checks.remediation: Open Google Play Store > Settings > Auto-update apps and select 'Over Wi-Fi only' or 'Over any network'.

checks.label: CIS 1.23 - Add Users From Lock Screen Disabled
checks.description: CIS 1.23: Ensure 'Add users from lock screen' is disabled to prevent unauthorized user creation
checks.remediation: Go to Settings > System > Multiple users and disable 'Add users from lock screen', or run: settings put global add_users_when_locked 0

checks.label: CIS 1.28 - User Profiles Count
checks.description: CIS 1.28: Review existing user profiles - ideally only 1 primary user should exist
checks.remediation: Go to Settings > System > Multiple users and remove any unnecessary user profiles.

checks.label: CIS 2.3 - Web Action Disabled
checks.description: CIS 2.3: Web and App Activity tracking should be disabled for privacy
checks.remediation: Disable Web and App Activity in Google Account settings, or run: settings put secure web_action_enabled 0

checks.label: CIS 2.3 - Assist Structure Disabled
checks.description: CIS 2.3: Assistant structure capture should be disabled for privacy
checks.remediation: Disable assistant screen context in Settings > Apps > Default apps > Assist app, or run: settings put secure assist_structure_enabled 0

checks.label: CIS 2.4 - Error Reporting Disabled
checks.description: CIS 2.4: Device information/error reporting should be disabled for privacy
checks.remediation: Disable usage and diagnostics reporting in Settings > Privacy, or run: settings put secure send_action_app_error 0

checks.label: CIS 2.11 - Bluetooth Scanning Disabled
checks.description: CIS 2.11: Ensure 'Bluetooth scanning' is disabled to prevent location tracking via BLE beacons
checks.remediation: Go to Settings > Location > Scanning and disable 'Bluetooth scanning', or run: settings put global ble_scan_always_enabled 0

checks.label: CIS 3.1 - Chrome Microphone Permission
checks.command: appops get com.android.chrome RECORD_AUDIO 2>/dev/null | grep -o 'allow\|deny\|ask\|ignore' | head -1
checks.description: CIS 3.1: Chrome microphone permission should require user confirmation (ask) not auto-allow
checks.remediation: Go to Settings > Apps > Chrome > Permissions > Microphone and set to 'Ask every time' or 'Deny'.

checks.label: CIS 3.2 - Chrome Location Permission
checks.command: appops get com.android.chrome COARSE_LOCATION 2>/dev/null | grep -o 'allow\|deny\|ask\|ignore' | head -1
checks.description: CIS 3.2: Chrome location permission should require user confirmation (ask) not auto-allow
checks.remediation: Go to Settings > Apps > Chrome > Permissions > Location and set to 'Ask every time' or 'Deny'.
